title: You Cast Level 3 Ban
description: You Cast Level 3 Ban — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_A

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Slay the Banned Farmers in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and then return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 4 King's Coins

Return to: QuestGiver_A

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Slay the Banned Farmers in Upper Ratsputin's Gulag and then return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

Disturbing. Very disturbing. It seems that the farmers you just banned have already made it back into the dungeon. I fear you may be too light on them and maybe they aren't taking you seriously. You did hit them upon the head with the ban stick, right? Well, never-the-less, they need to be taken care of before iVan becomes too rich and powerful to take on.

Level 1, the branch off of Level 1, Level 2, Level 3, the branch off of Level 3, Level 4, and the branch off of Level 4 are where the Banned Farmers can be found. Take care of them and return to me, Yakov Smearnov, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell once you have banned them yet again.

Turn-in:

Nice job out there, Dungeon Runner. Let me know when you are ready to do this quest again.

Objectives:

  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 1
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on the Level 1 Branch
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 2
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 3
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on the Level 3 Branch
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on Level 4
  • Slay the Banned Farmer on the Level 4 Branch

Client level range: 86–100
